issues.issue: Neither label says this is a reimbursement, so the category is a guess (same for detail[3]). It could be 'other'. Already marked review.

The amount is right. This line is warrants issued net of warrants retired, and it is recorded in other_financing. The other SIDs in this batch put the same activity in debt_proceeds and debt service principal. Defensible because the page prints only the net figure.
